note: Three hand-authored personas for the NICE-aligned diabetes review grader. calculateControl short-circuits to controlLevel 'draft' (score 0, no rules) whenever fewer than 2 of the 8 scored Likert/percentage items are answered AND no HbA1c is entered; otherwise controlScore is a weighted-average composite (HbA1c band 0/20/40/60/80/100 seeded as the base with weight 4, then medication adherence, diet adherence, and time-in-range each folded in at weight 1, then a complication penalty of min(5 x count, 30) subtracted) and controlLevel bands on that score (<=20 veryPoor, <=40 poor, <65 suboptimal, else wellControlled). detectAdditionalFlags is a split engine (mirrors form-app.js's own call: detectAdditionalFlags(state)) so its output is pinned here via flagsHint. VERIFIED ENGINE GAP (documented, not silently patched — fixing it would need a matching change to the SvelteKit reference engine this file is a port of, per its own header comment, and a clinical severity decision this session isn't positioned to make): retinopathyStatus has five options (none, background, preProliferative, proliferative, maculopathy) but only 'background' (DM-008, medium) and 'proliferative' (DM-004, high; FLAG-EYE-001, urgent) have a dedicated rule or flag. 'preProliferative' and 'maculopathy' correctly count toward countComplications() (so they still depress the composite score and correctly suppress DM-017's 'no complications' rule) but raise no eye-specific rule or flag at all — a clinician reading only the fired-rules/flags list would see no signal that a sight-threatening finding was recorded. The persona 'edge' below is built specifically to demonstrate this gap. Regenerate 'expected' with: bin/test-personas diabetes-assessment --update

personas.name: Well-controlled type 2, engaged and physically active
personas.description: HbA1c 48 mmol/mol (exactly at the <=48 band, hba1cScore 100), no complications, good medication and diet adherence (5/5 each), 85% time-in-range, regular physical activity, low distress and good coping. Composite: base 100 (weight 4) folded with adherence 100 (weight 1) -> (100*4+100)/5=100, diet 100 (weight 1) -> (100*5+100)/6=100, TIR 85 (weight 1) -> (100*6+85)/7=97.857142... -> round 98; no complications so no penalty. Expect controlLevel 'wellControlled', controlScore 98, and low-concern rules DM-016 (HbA1c at target), DM-017 (no complications), DM-018 (good diet), DM-019 (active), DM-020 (good psych) in registry order; no medium/high rules. Flags: none (no threshold in flagged-issues.js is crossed; hba1cTarget 53 >= hba1cValue 48 so FLAG-HBA1C-002 does not fire).

reviewCarePlan.clinicalNotes: Excellent control on metformin + dapagliflozin. Continue current regimen.

firedRules.description: No complications detected across all screening domains
Good psychological wellbeing (low distress, good coping)

personas.name: Pre-proliferative retinopathy - the invisible-eye-finding edge case
personas.description: Non-critical-severity edge case built to demonstrate the documented rule-coverage gap: retinopathyStatus 'preProliferative' (R2) is a real, sight-threatening finding but matches neither DM-004 (checks only 'proliferative') nor DM-008 (checks only 'background'), and flagged-issues.js only checks 'proliferative' for FLAG-EYE-001 - so this persona fires NO eye-category rule or flag despite the finding. It DOES still count toward countComplications() (so it silently depresses the score) and correctly blocks DM-017 ('no complications', which only tests for '' or 'none'). HbA1c 64 mmol/mol (hba1cScore 60, weight 4) folded with adherence 3/5->50 (weight 1) -> (60*4+50)/5=58, diet 3/5->50 (weight 1) -> (58*5+50)/6=56.333, TIR 55 (weight 1) -> (56.333*6+55)/7 -> 56.142857... -> round 56; one complication (the retinopathy) -> penalty 5 -> score 51. Expect controlLevel 'suboptimal' (score < 65), controlScore 51, fired rules DM-006 (HbA1c 64-85 suboptimal) only - no DM-004/DM-008/DM-017/DM-011 etc. Flags: exactly one, FLAG-HBA1C-002 (medium) - hba1cValue 64 > hba1cTarget 53 with a non-blank unit fires 'HbA1c above agreed target without treatment intensification' even though no OTHER threshold is crossed (eGFR normal, no hypertension, no CVD, moderate distress below the >=4 threshold, footRiskCategory 'moderate' not 'high').

reviewCarePlan.clinicalNotes: Pre-proliferative retinopathy on screening photographs 2026-06-11 - urgent ophthalmology referral made outside this tool's flag system (see referrals). HbA1c above target; discussed GLP-1 add-on.
reviewCarePlan.referrals: Urgent ophthalmology referral for R2 retinopathy (referred 2026-08-25, outside the engine's own flag logic)

additionalFlags.message: HbA1c above agreed target without treatment intensification

personas.name: Critical - very poor control with active foot ulcer and unrecognised severe hypoglycaemia
personas.description: Critical-highest persona. HbA1c 97 mmol/mol (>=97 crosses both DM-001's >=86 threshold and FLAG-HBA1C-001's own >=97 threshold; hba1cScore 0, weight 4) folded with adherence 1/5->0 (weight 1) -> 0, diet 1/5->0 (weight 1) -> 0, TIR 8 (weight 1) -> (0*6+8)/7 = 1.142857 -> round 1; five complications counted (retinopathy proliferative, neuropathy symptoms, eGFR<60, ulcer present, previous CVD event) -> penalty min(25,30)=25 -> score max(1-25,0)=0. Expect controlLevel 'veryPoor', controlScore 0. Fired rules in registry order: DM-001 (HbA1c>=86), DM-002 (severe hypo), DM-003 (foot ulcer), DM-004 (proliferative retinopathy), DM-005 (eGFR<30), DM-007 (recurrent hypo, daily), DM-009 is skipped (eGFR 28 fails the 30-59 band, DM-005 already covers <30), DM-010 (microalbuminuria, ACR 22 > 3), DM-011 (neuropathy symptoms), DM-012 (poor adherence 1/5), DM-013 is skipped (BMI 33.8 < 35), DM-014 (poor diet 1/5), DM-015 (high distress 5/5) - 11 rules total. Flags after the stable priority sort: urgent FLAG-HBA1C-001, FLAG-HYPO-002 (daily frequency + severe hypo -> unawareness), FLAG-FOOT-001, FLAG-EYE-001; high FLAG-HYPO-001, FLAG-RENAL-001, FLAG-CVD-001 (previous CVD, on statin but NOT on antihypertensive), FLAG-PSYCH-001 (distress = 5), FLAG-CVD-002 (current smoker); medium FLAG-HBA1C-002 (97 > target 58), FLAG-FOOT-002 (footRiskCategory 'high'), FLAG-SELF-001 (poor diet + sedentary + poor adherence = 3 of 3 poor domains), FLAG-CVD-003 (systolic 168 >= 140) - 13 flags total. FLAG-MED-001 does NOT fire (on insulin, but hypoglycaemiaFrequency is 'daily' not '', so the 'without documented hypoglycaemia assessment' condition is false). FLAG-RENAL-002 does not fire (ACR 22 is between 3 and 30, i.e. microalbuminuria not macroalbuminuria - only DM-010, a fired rule, not FLAG-RENAL-002).

reviewCarePlan.clinicalNotes: Same-day referral to diabetic foot MDT for active ulcer; urgent ophthalmology for proliferative retinopathy; nephrology referral for eGFR 28; admission considered for glycaemic crisis but patient declined, safety-netted with district nursing daily review.
reviewCarePlan.referrals: Diabetic foot MDT (urgent), ophthalmology (urgent), nephrology, psychology
